name: MILAN
systemNameStatus: Internal name for the consolidated MILAN codebase and operating model. The public product remains MILAN; no affiliation with Google or Meta is implied.

architecture.frontend: Static HTML, CSS, JavaScript and assets in frontend/.
architecture.api: Express application in backend/server.js; api/index.js exports it for the Vercel API entry point.
architecture.persistence: Supabase-backed users, record metadata/data and media paths are authoritative in the current main application.
architecture.identity: DID and per-user space identifiers provide logical application namespacing; they do not by themselves prove protocol-level DWN isolation.

realDwnProtocol.status: Not currently verified. Main API persistence metadata reports realDwnProtocol=false. The separate C++ component in DWN/ uses LevelDB and is not proven to be invoked by the main web API.

testMatrix.meaning: Cartesian product cardinality, not a claim that 10 million end-to-end tests have run. Unsupported cases must be reported as SKIP.

components.DWN/: Standalone C++20/LevelDB experiment; experimental integration status.
components.Travel-Agent/: FastAPI/LangGraph travel prototype; external provider/service deployment and authorization require separate verification.
components.DWN-Wallet/: Prototype component; in-memory implementation is not durable storage.
components.Milan-Sentinel/: Quality tooling with explicit PASS/FAIL/SKIP semantics.
components.Milan-RSI-Agent/: Repair-analysis experiment; patch push is opt-in.
components.Live-UI-Update/: UI/SEO automation tooling; frontend/ remains the production UI source of truth.

productionReadinessCaveat: Source inventory and passing smoke checks do not prove every feature, external service, credential, payment, data-retention rule or protocol guarantee is production-ready.
